suites.name: Expat UTF-8 upstream unit tests
command:
patch --batch --forward --fuzz=0 -d src -p1 < /recipe/ci/debian-bookworm-amd64/upstream-allocator-test.patch
make -C build/tests clean
status=0
make -C build/tests CPPFLAGS="$(dpkg-buildflags --get CPPFLAGS) -DXML_GE=1" check || status=$?
cat build/tests/runtests.log build/tests/runtestspp.log
exit "$status"
